rationale: Provisional, pending this PR's own cross-platform CI run (macOS arm64, macOS Intel, Windows x86_64; float32 and float64 presets) exercising tests/test_modulation_equivalence_cli.py's millisecond-scale Feedback Loop Modulation tracer -- see docs/adr/0001-cross-platform-reproducibility.md, which requires tolerances be set only from real empirical evidence across every supported platform, never guessed from one machine. Every entry below is committed at this same reasoning stage the tail-v1/tail-v2 tolerances files were before their own first CI run (see tail_tolerances_v2.json's rationale, which cites the specific CI run its final values came from) and MUST be replaced with values derived from this issue's own CI run before merge, each carrying its own observed delta and headroom the way tail_tolerances_v2.json's entries do. Until then: RT60-scale metrics (decayRt60Sec, predictedTargetRt60Sec, predictedRangeLow/HighRt60Sec) reuse tail_tolerances_v2.json's own float32/float64 values unchanged, because they are produced by the identical octave-band FFT/Schroeder/T20-T30 machinery this analyzer imports from analyze_tail_v2.py rather than recomputing -- the same arm64 FMA-contraction precedent documented there applies here unchanged. decayRelativeError likewise reuses that file's value directly (same ratio-of-decayRt60Sec-scale quantities). decayTiltSlopeRatioPerOctave and decayTiltInterceptRatio are new ratio-scale quantities (measured T30 divided by the loop's own rt60Sec, matching Damping's own ratio units) derived from the same underlying T30 fits, so they provisionally carry the same order-of-magnitude headroom as decayRelativeError. boundedEnergySlopeDbPerSegment reuses tail_tolerances_v2.json's eventualContractionSlopeDbPerSegment value unchanged: an identically-shaped late-tail log-energy regression slope over the same FMA-sensitive float32 DSP output. nonFiniteSampleCount reuses the exact-zero philosophy shared by every tolerances file in this repository (a discrete numerical-hygiene failure, not a floating-point accumulation). outputCorrelationMeanAbsoluteOffDiagonal and outputCorrelationMaxAbsoluteOffDiagonal are dimensionless [-1, 1] quantities computed by the same correlation_evidence() this repository's diffusion-equivalence tooling already carries cross-platform tolerances for (tools/diffusion_tolerances_v1.json), so they provisionally reuse that file's own correlation-metric headroom philosophy. coherentPitchMovementBroadbandMeanMagnitude and coherentPitchMovementMagnitude are new: raw (non-decibel) FFT magnitude sums over the render's own instantaneous-frequency signal, with no established scale precedent elsewhere in this repository -- their provisional tolerances are set as a small fraction of the value observed on this single local arm64 build (roughly 6.6e4 for the broadband mean and 5.2e6 for the configured-rate magnitude in the committed tracer), wide enough to tolerate the analogous float32-only FMA divergence tail-v2 observed at other stages of this same pipeline scaled up to this metric's much larger raw magnitude, and MUST be replaced first once this PR's own CI run reports real cross-platform deltas for exactly these two metrics.
